name: key-hints-tour
goal: Key hints in the bottom left corner (mockups touches v2 L2 + B1 + K5): on a real client, filmed, the real-input tour presses the keys the hints show and each one does what its drawing says: at night Tab opens the tablet (the hint turns into Tab close + the arrow towards the next screen), the arrow swipes, Tab closes it; Escape opens and closes the pause menu (hints hidden while it is open); at the vote recap T held opens the emote wheel (its hint is there in the seated view). The video is the evidence for the look; the events prove every key had its effect. Filmed on every process (the host's window is 1280 x 720, clients 640 x 360); -autoplay-tour-dwell keeps each state 1.5 s on screen.
